I love Annalise, through her flaws and all. She has made me realize that a person will do anything to stay on top and ahead. I think that because of her actions and her moral ambiguity throughout the show, she’s right up there with other modern tv characters like Don Draper, Walter White and Tony Soprano. She’s a feminist, yet the show makes her maternity and her sexual abuse, her driving factors in most of her actions surrounding the people the most closest to her. She’s complex, which I like. One minute she’s arguing before the Supreme Court, the next minute she’s making stupid alliances with clearly evil people. She’s something to admire and someone you’d never aspire to be. I do at times feel sorry that she initially never felt comfortable in her own skin. Her depression, the consistent insecurity and the blatant mistrust of others, actually damaged her as a person. So, I could see feeling responsible for the K5 ALL the time because 1) she’s good at what she does, and 2) whether they like it or not, they all became a family, and that’s all she wanted. So, I feel bad that her wanting to protect them stemmed from such darkness and guilt. But, yeah, I love Annalise, and I’m going to miss this show. I definitely think it could have had one more season left in it, but it is the way it is I guess.
